engine.version_requirement: No Native version selected; libsql 0.10.0-pre.4 is an upstream observed excluded specimen, not a Native dependency or support pin

frontend.protocol: libSQL embedded-replica page replication with remote-primary writes

connection.driver: no Native driver selected; excluded entry point libsql::Builder::new_remote_replica (upstream specimen 0.10.0-pre.4)

topology.logical_database_isolation: one local read replica and one authoritative remote libSQL namespace per logical database

operational_identity.write_authority: By default writes execute on and become authoritative at the remote libSQL primary, then reflect to the local replica; this is not Turso Database local-first push/pull authority.
operational_identity.consistency: Reads are local; default writes require the network and remote primary. Read-your-writes reflection and periodic/manual page sync do not make the local file authoritative.
operational_identity.file_semantics: The local file is a replaceable page-level read replica, not a Native source-of-truth artifact. Opening it independently while replication is active risks corruption and it is never a qualified Native snapshot.
provider_dependencies: libsql:// or https:// database URL and scoped authentication token
TLS-capable network path for writes and replica sync
provider page-replication, durability, backup, and restore behavior
promotion_rules: This legacy topology is deliberately excluded from the Turso local-first sync v1 support path.
The observed libsql 0.10.0-pre.4 API is recorded only to make the excluded constructor and topology concrete; it is not selected in Native's Cargo graph.
Vendor production support is not Native parity and creates no transferable evidence.
Any future Native use requires a separate decision, a new non-retired profile revision, and its own full logical, physical, operational, migration, backup, restore, and recovery evidence.
No local, direct-remote, or turso::sync evidence transfers to this profile.

native.domain-mcp.v1.notes: Excluded legacy topology; no Native adapter or transferable evidence.

native.canonical-interchange.v1.notes: Portable intent does not imply an implementation plan for this retired profile.
